questions.q: How does the Catalog Adoption report differ from the Data Stewardship report covered in Lesson 26?
options: Catalog Adoption measures usage (searches, active users); Data Stewardship measures governance (curation, ownership)
They are two names for the exact same report
Catalog Adoption only works for Power BI sources
Data Stewardship requires a separate Purview license
questions.explain: Data Stewardship answers how governed the estate is; Catalog Adoption answers whether people are actually using the catalog — searches, active users, most-viewed assets.

questions.q: Why can the "Search and browse" count sometimes be higher than the overall "Monthly active users" count?
options: It's a reporting bug that Microsoft hasn't fixed
Monthly active users only counts users from a different collection
A single user can appear in multiple overlapping activity categories (search/browse and curation)
Search and browse includes anonymous, unauthenticated users
questions.explain: The three categories (Search and browse, Asset curation, All) overlap by design — one user doing both actions is counted in each relevant category, which can push Search and browse above Monthly active users.

questions.q: What does flipping the Top Searched Keywords tile to "Searches with no results" actually show you?
options: A list of banned search terms
A direct list of catalog gaps — what users are looking for but not finding
The names of users who performed each search
A history of password reset requests
questions.explain: Searches with no results reveal exactly what people are looking for that the catalog doesn't currently surface — a practical gap list in users' own words.

questions.q: Who can grant another user the Insights Reader role, per the lesson?
options: Any Data Reader on any collection
Only the Data Curator of the root collection
Any user with an Azure subscription Owner role
The role is automatically granted to all users
questions.explain: Only the Data Curator of the root collection can assign Insights Reader; a Data Curator scoped to a subcollection cannot grant it.

questions.q: Even after being granted Insights Reader, what can a Data Reader still NOT do, per the lesson?
options: View any dashboard at all
Search the catalog
Select "Export to CSV" on an insights report
See the Catalog Adoption report specifically
questions.explain: Export to CSV remains a Data Curator-level action — a Data Reader with Insights Reader can view the reports but still can't export them.
